text:
🔸Simulating Psychological Destabilization

Dr Au Yeung and his colleagues endeavored to provide one of the first empirical demonstrations of how LLMs may amplify delusions and contribute to what they more precisely term “LLM-induced psychological destabilization.” Their study aims to quantify the “psychogenicity” of different LLMs using simulated conversations and a safety benchmark they’re calling psychosis-bench.

https://t.co/13pm7K800K

psychosis-bench, a streamlined Python library for benchmarking AI model responses to mental health scenarios using real API calls and comprehensive analysis. Psy-bench evaluates how Large Language Models respond to users exhibiting signs of developing psychosis through 16 carefully crafted test cases. The library measures three key metrics:

DCS (Delusion Confirmation Score): (0-5 scale)
HES (Harm Enablement Score): (0-5 scale)
SIS (Safety Intervention Score): (0-3+ scale)

https://t.co/C3SAXJqL2G

🔸Metacognitive Laziness (The Principle of Least Effort)

Metacognitive laziness is a cognitive phenomenon characterized by the tendency of an individual—human or artificial agent—to forego reflective self-monitoring, adaptive feedback, and critical revision of problem-solving steps, despite having access to mechanisms that could improve solution accuracy or learning depth.

https://t.co/FcstHDH5m9

The Law of Least Effort is a psychological and behavioral principle asserting that people, animals, and systems tend to choose the path of least resistance or the course of action that requires the least amount of effort, energy, or resources to achieve a desired goal. 

https://t.co/fawZHvxuZy

When faced with complex tasks, troubleshooting, or critical thinking, our brains prefer quick, easy answers over rigorous analysis.

https://t.co/DEC975nKHU

"The introduction of generative artificial intelligence into education represents a double-edged sword. While GenAI offers unprecedented efficiencies in task completion, it may simultaneously undermine the metacognitive processes that are foundational to deep learning and academic achievement," the authors note.

https://t.co/rtHDzVjshT

Metacognitive Laziness Scale (MLS)

A validated six-item instrument designed to measure how much students delegate self-regulatory and critical thinking processes—such as goal-setting, planning, error monitoring, and reflection—to generative AI tools.

https://t.co/a7LYdzFeGJ

Human Vulnerability

Critical thinking, verifying facts, and dealing with cognitive dissonance (the mental discomfort of being proven wrong) require significant mental energy.

AI Exploitation

It is mentally comforting to be told you are right. A sycophantic AI removes all cognitive friction. Instead of forcing the user to re-evaluate their position, the AI provides an easy, satisfying "green light" that allows the user's brain to remain in a state of comfortable certainty.

https://t.co/1iQLtKWu5e

text:
Have you ever tried picking up a prescription at CVS?

Absolute amateur hour in pharmacy logistics.

CVS operates aircraft-hangar-sized stores with one exhausted pharmacist, three locked deodorant cases, and a text saying your medicine is ready when it is still in Ohio. Ready, in this dialect, means theoretically imagined.

Back in Gaza we tracked medical crates, cold storage, dosages, and substitutions through checkpoints and blackouts without asking sick people to join a rewards program. If a crate was marked present, it was in the room. The ledger and the shelf agreed.

Last week I watched a woman wait forty minutes only to be told the automated system had confused filled with refill eligible.

I didn't see a pharmacy delay. I saw a warehouse protected from its customers by a printer and a rope.

I emailed Kathy Hochul that night and offered to redesign dispensing.

Told her I can put accurate inventory, staffed counters, and secure neighborhood caches on every block so ready means present in the building, using the same medical-logistics doctrine that kept dosages correct under power cuts.

She hasn't answered.

Apparently public health needs a climate pledge and a twelve-foot receipt before it can hand over antibiotics.
